goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy an upgrade there, press REBIRTH once you can afford it, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The playtester auto-claimed a plot, bought Dropper 2 and Dropper 3, and bought Silver Ore and Speed 1 from the SHOP. It also pressed REBIRTH several times, but only while unaffordable ($5000 needed, cash peaked around $1.8K, rebirth_denied=5), so the real rebirth was never tested. The Cash x1.5 and Gold Ore SHOP Buy buttons repeatedly failed to fire, and the TOP TYCOONS board showed an absurd $1T for the new player.

bugs.title: TotalEarned seeded at ~1 trillion; TOP TYCOONS board shows $1T for a new player
bugs.evidence: Steps 7, 9, 16, 17 and 18: the TotalEarned attribute read 1000000000259, then 1000000001675 and 1000000001717, while Cash was only 65 to 1.8K. The LeaderboardStand BackPanel read '1 | retailtycoonlover21 | R0 | $1T'. The leaderboard is meaningless and unfair, and rebirth or leaderboard logic could be skewed.

bugs.title: SHOP Buy buttons for Cash x1.5 and Gold Ore do not fire
bugs.evidence: Steps 9 and 10 (Card_mult1, price $300, cash 389 to 569), step 11 (Card_tier_gold) and step 18 (Card_tier_gold, cash 1.8K) all returned 'button did NOT fire'. Cash did not drop and the cards still read 'Buy', while the Dropper 2, Silver and Speed 1 cards worked in steps 2, 4 and 5. The cards may sit off-screen or be clipped in the scrolling list, or the Buy hit area may be misplaced. It consistently blocked buying these upgrades through the shop.

bugs.title: Touching the Cash x1.5 upgrade pad did not buy it
bugs.evidence: Step 15 go_touch on UpgradePad_mult1 reported 'touched' with 1.3K cash, but the position stayed [10.8, 4.1, 104.5]. The step 16 observation still lists 'Cash x1.5 | $300' as an available pad. Its purchase could not be confirmed by either the pad or the shop.

bugs.title: Rebirth path unverified: progress bar and denial feedback unclear
bugs.evidence: The REBIRTH $5000 button showed progress percentages that moved up and down (0%, 1%, 0%, 2%, 7%, 4%) as cash was spent. Pressing it unaffordably only incremented rebirth_denied (5). The HUD showed 'Need $X more', but the playtester never saw the player-facing denial message or a successful rebirth.
